history.summary: A 2001 99-yr leasehold 4BR in Bartley (D19), 1,551 sqft at $2.5M / $1,612 psf, 560m from Bartley MRT (Circle Line). The 6.9%/yr URA rate rests on only 16 transactions (unreliable), and at $1,612 psf the asking is ~17% ABOVE the $1,381 district median — an old, above-market leasehold at a $2.5M 4BR quantum. The poor 370 score reflects this; the strong Elo overstates a unit whose absolute fundamentals are weak.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $1,612 psf is ~17% above the $1,381 URA median — a clear pricing red flag for a 25-year-old 99-yr LH unit (~74 yrs lease left). The headline 6.9%/yr appreciation is unreliable on just 16 txn. $2.5M for a 4BR thins the buyer pool. score_1000 370 (well below market-typical) captures the cost/lease/quantum drag; the high Elo is a head-to-head artefact, not a fundamentals signal. Bartley CCL MRT at 560m is the one genuine strength keeping it off Avoid.
red_flags: Asking PSF ~17% above the $1,381 URA district median — overpriced
